## Interactive Comparisons & ROI Calculators

### n8n vs Zapier vs Make Pricing Calculator (2026–2027): Real Annual Self-Hosted Savings
- URL: https://gabhack.github.io/turingtec-agent-studio/compare/n8n-vs-zapier-vs-make-calculator/
- BLUF: At 10,000 monthly workflow runs averaging 6 steps (60,000 tasks/month), Zapier costs ~$5,748/year and Make costs ~$1,284/year—while self-hosted Docker n8n runs for ~$180/year (~$15/mo VPS, $0 software license), saving up to $5,568/year.
- Overview: Per-task SaaS automation pricing punishes AI agents that run multi-step loops, webhooks, and LLM retries. Use the interactive slider calculator below to model your real monthly runs and step counts across Zapier, Make, and self-hosted n8n.

### AWS FinOps Open-Source Tools Compared (2026–2027): aws-finops-guard vs Infracost vs OpenCost vs Cost Explorer
- URL: https://gabhack.github.io/turingtec-agent-studio/compare/aws-finops-open-source-tools/
- BLUF: Infracost estimates pre-deploy Terraform PR costs, OpenCost tracks Kubernetes pods, and AWS Cost Explorer shows historical spend—while aws-finops-guard audits live AWS + LLM token waste locally via CLI or Claude/Cursor MCP Server and outputs ready-to-apply Terraform HCL fixes.
- Overview: Modern cloud teams leak 25–40% of their budget across unattached EBS volumes, idle NAT Gateways, legacy gp2 storage, and unrouted LLM API calls. Compare the top FinOps tools objectively below and estimate your exact recoverable AWS + AI waste.
